system: Two-digit Arabic-Indic numeral groups using the digits 1-9 only (26 distinct values in 119 groups, first digit nearly always 1,2,3,5,6,7 or 8 and second 2,4,5,7,8 or 9), with clear Arabic words between some groups; the system is not established.
